notes.title: Name Change
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that we've changed our name from "Bricking it!" to "BrickWorks"!

Rest assured, our passion for our work remains the same while the name changes. We're still the same reliable team you know and trust, and we look forward to continuing to provide top-notch brick-related solutions.

Thank you for being part of our journey, and we can't wait to continue building with you under our new name, BrickWorks!

- The BrickWorks Team
